descriptive_title: Guarded Reflective Cartesian Closure with Certified Refinement
claim: A Cartesian-closed guarded semantic core, typed reflection over explicit program representations, an external certified semantic-refinement/improvement preorder on an explicitly admitted program or morphism relation domain, and guarded recursion are to be combined into a coherent bounded self-replacement mechanism beneath a fixed verification/admission kernel.

concrete_model_candidate.name: topos_of_trees
concrete_model_candidate.model_role: ambient Cartesian-closed guarded semantics; refinement is supplied by a separate admitted-program relation, not by an order on every hom-set

typed_reflection.scope: closed intrinsically well-typed syntax for an admitted object language

refinement.placement: external certified preorder on an explicitly admitted program/morphism relation domain
refinement.relation_domain: typed admitted programs or represented morphisms for which the refinement relation is explicitly defined
refinement.operational_quality: Q represented separately from semantic refinement
preorder_targets: reflexivity on the declared relation domain
transitivity on the declared relation domain
compatibility_targets: composition is monotone in each argument when all terms lie in the declared refinement domain
currying is order-preserving for declared related morphism representations
evaluation is order-preserving for declared related function and argument representations
refinement.non_claim: Set^(omega^op) is not being claimed order-enriched merely because the admitted program layer carries this preorder

executable_instance.capability_refinement: preserve every previously answered value and weakly extend competence domain
executable_instance.optimization_strictness: identical answer vector and strictly lower declared cost

preservation_theorem_target.assumption: trusted checker is sound for the admitted certificate language, declared refinement relation domain, and fixed evaluation context
conclusions: monotone external semantic refinement for accepted replacements
strict declared quality progress when optimization mode is used
layer_order: refinement compatibility on the declared external relation domain

stop_or_narrow_criteria: the ambient guarded CCC cannot support the typed semantics without changing the admitted claim
reflection requires unrestricted quotation or self-application outside the intake boundary
the declared external refinement relation cannot satisfy its scoped compatibility laws
preservation depends on an unstated oracle or mutable trust anchor
bounded checker cannot reject the declared adversarial fixtures under fixed context
formal and executable artifacts cannot be bound to one exact manifest

fixed_components: evaluator/interpreter semantics used by the checker

non_goals: ambient order enrichment of all hom-sets of Set^(omega^op)
self-replacement of the complete trust base
